sections.heading: The mistake to avoid
sections.content: A brand-new PM shouldn’t try to overhaul the whole product review cycle when the head of product is invested in it. Lane suggests borrowing a decision template or another ritual that has helped a team before and using it with your own team instead. Rituals may also need adapting rather than copying exactly, since the details can matter.
